scope: V3-06 static 2D Tilemap consumption in the actual target Canvas, using existing pixel-data-consumption; no new task schema, check ID, database objects or frontend integration

baselineReproduction.case: Correct independent Tilemap renderer + registered Scene/Grid/TileSet/atlas
baselineReproduction.observation: Pixel probe must select an actual registered image binding (Scene requires exact componentId)
baselineReproduction.rootCause: Pixel preparation only supported sprite/image bindings and did not resolve Tilemap cells through their registered TileSet

implementation.selection: Existing pixelProbes identify the exact registered Scene node/component and actual Canvas; host derives every used tileId and all its cells, not an author-picked representative cell
implementation.geometry: Existing Grid/TileSet parser and scene hierarchy/camera projection; negative cell coordinates, gap, anchor, tile pivot/offset/size; axis-aligned nonoverlapping static rectangles only
implementation.observation: Host-owned Chromium renders the independent target build; two image/atlas-region marker responses plus node position, cell position, Grid cell size and TileSet tile size response mutations, followed by original Canvas hash restoration
implementation.cellProof: Each individual cell's interior must match marker color at least 90 percent; two-pixel boundary tolerance; no marker pixels outside all expected cell rectangles
implementation.resourceIdentity: Actual registered image paths and atlas rectangles, not frame names alone; overlapping regions across bindings remain unverified
implementation.sourceProtection: Source/build Scene, TileSet, manifest modules, selected images and atlas bytes are version-bound. Browser mutations are response-only; tests assert original source files unchanged
implementation.versionPolicy: Old .1 evidence remains saved but is not current .2 evidence. Explicit remeasurement is required; no automatic task rerun

tilemapCases.interiorOmission: 11 cells share one tileId; omitting the middle cell preserves the total bounding box and more than 90 percent aggregate coverage. Individual-cell checks still fail it
tilemapCases.currentEvidence: Passed .2 result is current; the same result labeled .1 is not current; changing TileSet bytes makes the saved result noncurrent

frozenRegression.coverage: Existing sprite/UI consumption, standalone debug/actual CLI with offline model, Review/Question/Repair, measured Preview/export, binding, changes and recovery, plus 18 Tilemap cases
frozenRegression.intermediateRuns: Initial restricted browser launch failed with macOS sandbox Input/output error. Authorized focused browser run passed 37 cases before the final alias/individual-image cases were added; only the frozen full run is final evidence. No browser safety flags were weakened

boundaries.testBrowser: Existing owned independent Chromium and synthetic OS temporary directories; full suite includes existing independent debug/CLI regressions, not another remote database UI acceptance
notProven: rotated/sheared, overlapping, tinted/occluded visuals or shared image/frame regions across bindings
semantic Review quality, aesthetics or complete game quality
